$comment: Street life: cash, skills that grow with use, sprint stamina, side gigs and texts. Rules are in game/life-core.js; this file is the tuning and the content. Every gig start, stop and spot is on a sidewalk clear of solids (the street-life smoke checks them against the generated city). Cash only buys comforts: nothing here gates a mission, a mix or a tape.

stamina.$comment: Seconds of sprint by Legs level 1–5. Sprint comes back after regenDelay seconds, over regenSeconds, restBoost times faster standing still. Empty means winded until it is back to windedUntil.

skills.$comment: xp thresholds for levels 1–5, shared by all four. payPerLevel is the gig bonus per level above 1 in the gig's own skill.

gigs.name: CRATE RUN
gigs.pitch: Three orders, one hot crate. Club first, then the yards, then the Mainframe lobby.

gigs.name: FLYER DROP
gigs.pitch: Fresh off the screen. Five stoops in the Heights before the ink is dry. On foot or on a board.

gigs.name: WATERFRONT LINE
gigs.pitch: One loop of the Heights on a board. Stay on it. Kickflips between gates pay extra.

gigs.name: FIND THE DJ
gigs.pitch: Pop-up set tonight. No address. Your phone picks up the signal: more bars, closer.

gigs.name: CROSSTOWN RUN
gigs.pitch: Four signatures across four districts. Take a car. I’ve marked them in order.

texts.body: You’re on the block now. If you need pocket money, open Gigs on your phone. I always have a crate that’s late.
You found one of Raf’s tapes?? BADCO FM should be up on your dial now. There are more out there. Stoops, mostly.
Five tapes. You’re digging properly. If you get stuck, the Tapes app sells tips. I’m not proud of it.
The whole shelf. Nobody’s done that. Go look at it in the Lab, every spine has a sticker.
Paid. See, the city’s nicer with twenty dollars in your pocket. Coffee carts take cash.
All three signed for. The club said the crate was still warm. Same time tomorrow?
They closed the door on you. It happens. Take a car next time, the yards are further than they look.
Five stoops, no smudges. I’ll print you something for the wall. Come by the table.
Ink dried before you got there. Pace yourself: sprint the straights, walk the corners.
Clean line. People on the promenade actually clapped. Throw more flips in next time, they pay.
You got off the board. The whole point is the board.
You found it. I saw you at the back. Next one’s somewhere else, that’s the game.
Set’s over. Watch the bars on your phone, not the street signs.
Nico here. I hear you finish what you start. Crosstown Run is on your phone now. It pays like a real job.
Four signatures, four districts. I’ve never had that back before the desk closed.
You’re getting quick. Come run with us at the waterfront some time.
Saw the photo. You’ve got an eye. Try Disposable flash at night, outside the club.
Cart coffee. Now you live here.
Five hundred in your pocket. Don’t let it change you. The valet will bring your car round for twenty.
